# EmDash CMS & Astro SEO Suite
> High-performance edge-rendered SEO architecture with Rank Math and Yoast migration support.

Website: https://example.com
Documentation: https://example.com/docs
Sitemap: https://example.com/sitemap.xml

## Architecture
- Framework: Astro 7 + EmDash CMS 1.0
- Runtime: Cloudflare Workers (Free Tier & Paid compatible)
- SEO Suite: @emdash/plugin-seo (in-process native plugin)

## Core Capabilities
- Connected Schema Graph: JSON-LD @graph linking Organization, WebSite, WebPage, Services, and BreadcrumbList
- Automated Breadcrumbs: Dynamic Google BreadcrumbList schema and accessible UI breadcrumbs
- Automated Table of Contents: Heading anchor injection and Google ItemList jump-link schema
- Automated FAQ Blocks: Google FAQPage schema with accessible accordions
- Content Analyzer: Real-time on-page SEO auditor (keyword density, placements, word count)
- Edge Protocols: Streaming XML sitemaps, virtual robots.txt, and AI search llms.txt
- Edge Redirections: Sub-millisecond 301, 302, and 410 redirect matching

## Migration Support
- WordPress REST API ingestion (Application Passwords)
- Rank Math Pro & Yoast SEO Premium metadata normalization
- Automated custom redirection import (`wp_rank_math_redirections`)
